title: Patient Financial Assistance Program: Assistance Cases a Patient May Hold Over Time
content:
**Clause.** Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program a patient accumulates assistance cases over time: applications, renewals, denials and expired awards each remain on file as cases. The number of cases a patient may have on file is not capped. The number of cases that may be live at the same time is set by the program's one-live-case rule.

## The clause in parts

| Question the clause answers | Answer |
|---|---|
| Does a new application, a renewal, a denial or an expired award leave a case on file? | Yes; each is held as a case. |
| Is there a maximum number of cases on file for one patient? | No; the number on file is not capped. |
| Does this clause limit how many cases may be live at once? | No; that limit is set by the one-live-case rule. |

## Illustration (hypothetical history)

A patient's file shows a case denied two years ago, an award that expired last year, and a renewal case submitted this month. All three remain on file; nothing in this clause removes a closed case or limits how many closed cases the patient holds.
